lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are organized in a repeating geometric grid posterior to the gill slits, consisting of four distinct horizontal rows of local maxima with consistent inter-centroid spatial intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, forming a series of grid-like nodes where the highest luminance values are concentrated.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high pixel intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs, with a higher concentration of smaller clusters along the anterior margin and sparse patterning toward the posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent V-shaped notch or tissue deficit is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin. The first dorsal fin also exhibits a jagged, irregular posterior silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, low-luminance silhouettes corresponding to commensal fish are visible adhering to the ventral-lateral region of the flank.
